Justine, saw HungerRush leaning into AI ordering for 2026, with OrderAI and text marketing front and center as the category shifts.

When a product story moves that fast, the list of restaurants and operators worth a conversation usually grows faster than any seller can personally work, and good accounts slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for HungerRush off your product and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HungerRush needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
